tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// bum gter gzhug pa'i man ngag gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhugs so// klu bum gyi sgrub thabs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ mchod rten nam/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ khang bzang la sogs bzhengs pa'i gzhir bum gter 'jug par 'dod na/ bum pa yul gang yin gyi bre tshad pas mi chung ba'i bcud shong ba/ rin po che'i bum pa'am/ rdza la sogs pa'i yin na'ang gtsang ma'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ 'bru bcud dang sman dang dri bzang po nor sna dang*/ zas sna gos sna la sogs pa bcug la bsham/ de'ang 'byor na phyogs mtshams dbus dang dgur re re/ de ma 'byor na phyogs bzhir dbus dang lngar re re/ yang na dbus su gcig 'jug pa yin/ de la bdag gi rnal 'byor gang yang rung ba bsgoms nas/ bzlas pa cung zad byas la bum gter bshams pa de/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis zad mi shes pa'i gter dang longs spyod dang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas bum pa'i stod kyi char/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang 'dab ma dgu rnams la nāṃ dgu las klu dgu bskyed par bya ste/ dbus su nor rgyas/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du ba ru ṇa/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa stod lha'i lus can phyag gnyis kas rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha dog dag pa'i shel ltar dwangs shing yul gyi dbang por sna tshogs su snang ba/ spyi gtsug na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang bcas pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa g.yon phyogs nas rang dang 'dra ba'i chung mas bsten par bskyed nas/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/

oṃ e h+ye hi nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bstims nas/ re re la'ang mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po dbul zhing re re'i mchod pa'i mthar sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza bā su kā ya phuḥswā hā/ nor rgyas kyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza karko ṭā ya phuḥswā hā/ stobs kyi rgyu'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza shaṃ kha pā lā ya phuḥswā hā/ dung skyong gi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza a nan+tā ya phuḥswā hā/ mtha' yas kyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ba ru ṇā ya phuḥswā hā/ chu bdag ba ru ṇa'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza tak+ṣa kā ya phuḥswā hā/ 'jog po'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ku li kā ya phuḥswā hā/ rigs ldan gyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza pad+mā ya phuḥswā hā/ pad+ma'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ma hā pad+mā ya phuḥswā hā/ pad+ma chen po'i 'o// mchod pa dang sngags rnams spel zhing byas nas/ klu'i gtor ma brgya rtsa la sogs phul la dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ 'dom gang la sogs pa'i sa brkos pa'i 'og tu byi dor legs par byas shing*/ sman dang dri bzang dang bcas te sa bzang po'i gnas su legs par bzhag la sgrom bu la sogs byas pa'i steng du sa gtsang mas legs par bkang ste 'thas par bya/ de'i steng du zhag bdun la sogs par dus gsum du mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul/ der dkon mchog gi rten la sogs pa bzhengs par bya'o// de ltar byas pas 'byor pa dang*/ lo legs pa dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yin no// bum gter gzhug pa'i man ngag bla ma sa skya pas mdzad pa'o// rten bzhengs pa ma yin pa'i gter bum 'jug na'ang*/ khang bzang ngam/ klu gnas pa'i sar bcug na yul der dpal 'phel bar 'gyur bas tshul 'di bzhin shes par bya'o// ༈ /bum gter gzhug pa'i lag len bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/

mchod rten nam/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ khang bzang la sogs pa bzhengs pa'i gzhir bum gter 'jug par 'dod na/ bum pa yul gang yin gyi bre tshad bas mi chung ba'i bcud shong ba lcags dang ra gan dang zha nye ma 'dres pa'i rin po che'i bum pa'am/ rdza la sogs pa'i bum pa yin na'ang gtsang ma'i nang du/ lcags/ ra gan/ zha nye gsum ma gtogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ ske tshe/ shang tshe/ bra bo sran ma rnams ma gtogs pa'i 'bru bcud dang*/ khyung sder/ tsha ba gsum/ dug rigs/ gla rtsi rnams ma gtogs pa'i sman dang*/ dri bzang po dang*/ nor sna dang*/ sha chang ma 'dres pa'i zas sna/ gos sna la sogs pa bcug la bsham/ 'jim pas kha bcad la dkar zhal gyis byug mgrin pa yan chad ras gtsang mas dkri/ de yang 'byor na phyogs mtshams brgyad dbus dang dgur re re/ de ma 'byor na phyogs bzhir dbus dang lngar re re/ yang na dbus su gcig 'jug pa yin/ de la bdag gi rnal 'byor seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs sogs gang yang rung ba bsgoms nas bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ bum gter bshams pa de gzhi gtsang ma la/ tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du bzhag chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod tshar dgu'am/ ma 'byor na gcig dang*/ gtor ma dgu bshams la/ bum pa yak+ṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ rin po che dang*/ 'bru bcud zas nor sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar bskyed de/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgyas sbyang ba ni thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas yo byad ma dag pa rnams sbyangs te skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i tshigs bar ma rnams bcag pa dpral bar bzhag la/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par bsam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags rgyas bsgyur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i kha gyen du phye ste mthe bong bsnol la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas rdzas rnams mgron so so'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgyas spyod par dbang ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pas 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes par 'byung bar bsam/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgyas thob par bya ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa snying gar bzhag g.yon mthe bong lag mthil du bzhag pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas pa/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te/ na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ zhes pas lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes shing sems can rnams yo byad la rgyal pham dang rtsod pa med par so so'i mos pa bzhin thob par bsam/ dbang sgyur 'khor lo'am/ lha mgon spyi'i sngags rgyas dbang du bya ba ni/ sor mo nang du bsnol ba'i rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs la/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ti mahā sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes pas mgron thams cad kyang dam tshig dbang gis bdag la 'go zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i phrin las 'ba' zhig sgrub par bsams te/

phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum la sogs pa brjod do// de ltar sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis yo byad rnams zad mi shes pa'i gter dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlab nas/ de lta bu'i bum pa'i stod kyi char pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la nāṃ dgu las klu dgu bskyed par bya ste/ dbus su nor rgyas/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du wa ru ṇa/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ stod lha'i lus can/ phyag gnyis kas rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha dog dag pa'i shel ltar dwangs shing yul gyi dbang por sna tshogs su snang ba/ spyi gtsug na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang bcas pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon phyogs nas rang dang 'dra ba'i chung mas bsten pa bskyed nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod pas spyan drangs shing gnyis su med par bstims nas/ mchod pa rnams yo ga ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ nor rgyas la/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza bā su ki phuḥ.ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs mtshan sngags re re zhing sbyar ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*// bsten la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal nor rgyas khyod la bstod par bgyi// zhes pas bstod/

gong gi sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma rgya chen po mtshan sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pas dbul zhing*/ klu gzhan rnams la'ang mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'don pa bsgyur la bya/ re re'i mchod bstod rdzogs pa'i mthar sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza bā su kā ya phuḥswā hā// nor rgyas so// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza karko ṭā ya phuḥswā hā/ stobs kyi rgyu'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza shaṃ kha pā lā ya phuḥswā hā/ dung skyong gi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza a nan+tā ya phuḥswā hā/ mtha' yas kyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza wa ru ṇā ya phuḥswā hā/ chu bdag wa ru ṇa'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza tak+ṣa kā ya phuḥswā hā/ 'jog po'i 'o// oṃ phuḥg rā dza ku li kā ya phuḥswā hā/ rigs ldan gyi'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza pad+mā ya phuḥswā hā/ pad+ma'i 'o// oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ma hā pad+mā ya phuḥswā hā/ pad+ma chen po'i 'o// de ltar so so'i mchod pa dang*/ sngags dang gtor ma rnams spel zhing byas nas/ thun mong du dkar gtor cha bzhi'i nang gi klu'i gtor ma brgya rtsa la sogs pa phul la/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gam yul phyogs 'dir dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas 'dom gang la sogs pa'i sa brkos pa'i 'og tu byi dor legs par byas shing*/ sman dang dri bzang dang bcas pa'i sa bzang po'i gnas su legs par bzhag la sgrom bu la sogs pa byas pa'i steng du sa gtsang mas legs par bkang ste 'thas par bya/ de'i steng du zhag bdun la sogs par dus gsum du mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul/ der dkon mchog gi rten la sogs pa bzhengs par bya'o// de ltar byas pas 'byor pa dang lo legs pa dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yin no// rten bzhengs pa ma yin pa'i gter bum 'jug na'ang khang bzangs sam/ klu gnas pa'i sar bcug na yul der dpal 'phel bar 'gyur bas tshul 'di bzhin shes par bya'o// bum gter gzhug pa'i man ngag bla ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa gzhir bzhag ste/

gsal byed cung zad bar skabs su zhabs tog gi tshul du sbyar ba 'di'ang don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ du bris pa'o// bag zan la klu gzugs byas nas bum nang du 'jug pa sogs lag len ma dag pa rnams kyis 'di la bsre bslad ma byed cig/ ༈ /bum gter lhan thabs bzhugs/ bum gter gyi phyag len rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yig char mi gsal ba/ sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung cung zad brjod na/ bum pa rnams dkar zhal gyis byug mdun mi 'khrugs pa'i rtags bya/ sbyin bdag sogs kyis 'byor na klu re re la bum pa re re ste dgu bya/ dbus kyi bum pa'i mdun 'jig rten pa'i shar la bstan/ phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi bum pa'i mdun dbus su bstan/ yang bum pa gcig dang lnga la sogs pa byed na bum pa re re'i nang du klu dgu/ pad 'dab kyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams su bskyed/ bum pa gcig yin na mdun 'jig rten pa'i shar du bstan/ lnga yin na dbus kyi bum pa'i mdun gong bzhin shar dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i mdun dbus su bstan/ bum nang du bag zan dang 'jim pa las klu gzugs bcos nas 'jug pa ni mi legs te chag grum gyi skyon byung na phan las gnod che bas mi legs pas spang bar bya'o// sa lo chen pos dug shing ma yin pa'i shing leb sgor mo yu ba cung zad yod pa la klu'i gzugs bskyed chog dang mthun pa chung ma dang bcas pa bris la/ kha ches byugs pa bum pa'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ dbus su nor rgyas zhal bum pa'i mdun phyogs dang*/ gzhan phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ shar phyogs su stobs rgyu sogs zhal dbus su bstan pa bcug de steng 'bru sogs kyis bkang ba mdzad pas 'di ni las dang po pa rnams dmigs pa gsal bas shin tu legs par mngon la/ yang ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pa dang ri mo ba sogs ma 'byor na rje sa skya pa chen po'i gsung bzhin bya'o// bdag bskyed seng ge sgra/

mjug gi bzlas pa'i mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab par bya/ dam ye phye ba mi 'jug go /bum gter rnams gzhi gtsang ma la/ bum pa du yod na re ga la sogs pa tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad che bar bris/ lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la bum pa dgu po bkod/ yang bum pa lnga dang gcig la sogs pa dang*/ phyogs gcig bsgrubs nas nam dgos dus byas chog pa'i dbang du byas te/ bum pa la sogs pa du yod na'ang*/ bum pa re re'i nang du/ klu dgu ka bskyed pa yin pas/ pad 'dab brgyad pa chung ngu re bris la/ de steng bum pa re 'jog pa yin no// yang tshon la sogs pa ma 'byor na/ nas 'bras gang rung gis bum pa re la tshom bu brgyad re bkod pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi mtshon byed du mdzad pa phyag len ltar byas la de steng 'jog pa yin no// mchod gtor rnams 'byor na klu re re la dmigs nas tshar re bsham pa yin no// ma 'byor na tshar gcig gtor ma rnams la khur ba sogs skam gyi rigs/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ ka ra/ 'o ma/ mar thud la sogs pa dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi kha zas gtsang ma/ rgu 'brum sogs shing thog gi rigs gang 'dzom gtor ma'i mthar bzhag 'di rnams la sha chang la sogs pa klu la gnod pa'i rigs cung zad tsam yang ma 'dres pa dang*/ khyad par rdzas dang yo byad thams cad gtsang sbra shin tu che ba rang dgos so// sngags drug phyag drug gi skabs su/ 'go zhing srung skyob mdzad nas zhes pa'i rjes su bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ phan bde'i phrin las 'ba' zhig sgrub cing sems can gyi don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzad par gyur/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan zhing zhes pa sngags re brjod pa dang bstun/ phyag rgya gnas so sor bskor te phyogs bcur bstan pa'i mos pa byed pa yin/ gtor ma'i rjes su mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid klu rgyal nor rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo// bdag dang sbyin bdag la klu'i gnod pa mi 'byung zhing yul phyogs 'dir dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes pa'i 'dod don gsol gdab dang*/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu'ang*/ klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas 'khor dang bcas pas/ bdag dang sbyin bdag la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa stsal zhing gnas 'dir bkra shis dang dge legs 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes smon lam btab gzhan la'ang klu'i ming bsgyur ma gtogs 'dra/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya lag pa g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa'i mthe bong dang mthe'u chung bsgreng*/ g.yas kyi sor mo rnams sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka ltar bsgrengs nas/ g.yon gyi mthe bong gi steng du gdugs phub pa ltar sbyar la bskor zhing*/ oṃ hi li sogs dang*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa sogs brgya rtsa gcig gis gtor ma phul/ ting shag rdung zhing klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis sogs 'dod don gsol gdab kyi tshe/ sbyin bdag gam nad pa yod na de'i ming nas brjod pa sogs sbyar ro// rdo sgrom du 'jug tshe 'jim pa sogs kyis tshags bsdam/ klu la mi gnod pa'i dri bzang bsres pa'i sa bkram zhing bcags/ de'i steng du chu rdo gtsang mas cung zad bkang ba'i steng*/ ras sam dar dkar po sogs gtsang ma bkram/ nas 'bras sogs 'bru sna dang dar sna tshogs rin po che sogs dri bzang dang bcas pa'i steng du bum pa gong du bshad pa ltar mang nyung la dpag pa'am/ mdun 'jig rten pa'i shar du bstan la bzhugs su gsol/ de'i gong du bshad pa ltar gyi 'bru la sogs pa thams cad gang 'dzom blug dar ram ras 'og tu btings pas gril te bzhag go /de'i mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma zas sna thams cad spungs/ de'i steng dang logs thams cad chu rdel gtsang mas srub med par bkang 'di ni byi ba'i skyon med pa'i ched yin/ de'i steng sa gtsang ma mchod pa'i chu dang dri bzang gis sbags pa'i 'jim pas bkang la 'thas par bcags/ de'i steng rdo'am g.yam pa rgya che bas bkab la bum pa la skyon mi 'byung bar byas te/ de'i khar sa ji ltar rigs par brdung zhing 'thas par bcags/

gzhan yang zhal ba la sogs pa gang 'os gzhan gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ba thabs sna tshogs bya/ de nas bkra shis sogs 'dra/ yang bum pa dgu dang lnga la sogs pa 'jug na'ang gong bzhin gyi sgrom bu sogs bum pa'i grangs dang bstun nas byed/ mdun ston tshul gong bsham gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar yin/ bum pa lhag ma rnams sha chang gi dri med pa'i sa phyogs gtsang mar 'bru la sogs pa'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ nam dgos dus spyan drangs nas gong bzhin mchod gtor phrin bcol sogs byas la/ bum pa rnams 'jug lugs gang 'os/ bkra shis dang zhag bdun gyi bar klu gtor gtong ba sogs lag len thams cad gong dang 'dra bar bya'o// 'di'ang dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
